title: FBI Photo B7
what_is_it: A monochrome still image (photo) captured by a U.S. military sensor system, submitted by the FBI to AARO as part of a UAP report.
interpretation_warnings: The HUD overlay text is almost entirely illegible due to image quality and OCR degradation — extracted text fragments are unreliable.
The displayed date (42/24/99) is confirmed fictitious due to unconfigured system clock; the actual date is unknown beyond 'late 2025'.
The imagery was pre-redacted by the FBI before submission to AARO, meaning potentially important contextual information has been removed.
No mission report accompanied this image, so there is no supporting narrative from the operator beyond the inability to identify the object.
One of the two objects visible is described as consistent with a helicopter, meaning only the second smaller circular object is the unidentified anomaly.
Single-source submission with no corroborating sensor data or witness statements provided.

verifiable_claims.claim: The date displayed in the image (42/24/99) is incorrect because the system date/time was not set
